lane: صَفُوفٌ A she-camel _that yields a row of bowls of her milk_ (تَصُفُّ أَقْدَاحًا مِنْ لَبَنِهَا S, O, K) _when she is milked,_ (S, O,) _because of the abundance of her milk:_ (S, O, K:) or _for which two vessels are set side by side_ (يُصَفُّ), _and which fills them:_ (Ham p. 535:) or _that sets her fore legs evenly, side by side,_ (تَصُفُّ يَدَيْهَا, [see 1,]) _on the occasion of being milked._ (S, M, O, K.) [See an ex. in a verse cited voce صُوفٌ. And see also ضَفُوفٌ.]
